criteria.criterion: `_build_jira_backend` raises `BackendEnvError` (naming every missing var + the anonymous-access consequence) when `JIRA_URL`, `JIRA_USER`, or `JIRA_API_TOKEN` is empty or whitespace-only, BEFORE constructing the `AcliClient`.

`_build_jira_backend` raises `BackendEnvError` naming `JIRA_USER` when the user is present but not an email (contains no `@` / empty local or domain part); a valid email — including `+tag` subaddressing and subdomains — is accepted.
The absence-doc test `test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly` is flipped to assert the loud failure (behaviour parity with DC's `test_dc_pat_required_heldout.py`).

`test_the_cloud_factory_also_asserts_conformance` still passes: its fixture creds are made a valid email so the credential guard passes and the conformance assertion (`set_reporter`) is still reached; its assertion is unchanged.
DC behaviour and tests are unchanged (Cloud-only change).
